sloka: वाचा मधुरया रामः स्र्वं सम्मानयन् जनम् ।मातुस्समीपं धीरात्मा प्रविवेश महायशाः ॥२-१९-३८॥
transliteration: vācā madhurayā rāmaḥ srvaṁ sammānayan janam ।mātussamīpaṁ dhīrātmā praviveśa mahāyaśāḥ ॥2-19-38॥

translations.english: Firmminded and illustrious Rama treated all people with sweet words and approached his mother.
